title: Eternal IoT — ESP32 Smart Lock NFC & Sensor (PostgreSQL)

options.content:
## 🛡️ Eternal IoT Pipeline (PostgreSQL Architecture)
**Flow:** `ESP32 Hardware` ➔ **Mosquitto MQTT (:1883)** ➔ **PAP Core Worker (MqttPgConsumer)** ➔ **PostgreSQL eternal_iot (:5432)** ➔ **Grafana (:3001)**

- **Hardware ESP32:** Hanya terhubung ke MQTT dan REST API PAP Core (`:8000`). Tidak ada koneksi database langsung.
- **PostgreSQL DB:** Dedicated database `eternal_iot` untuk sinkronisasi kartu NFC, log audit akses, telemetry timeseries, dan state kunci.

panels.title: 🔐 Status Kunci
panels.description: Status solenoid/relay terakhir dari ESP32 (is_locked: 0 = terbuka, 1 = terkunci).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_locked = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status" FROM device_locks WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

panels.title: ⏳ Sisa Timer Auto-Lock (maks 2 jam)
panels.description: Hitung mundur sebelum kunci otomatis terkunci kembali (7200 detik = 2 jam).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_locked = 0 AND unlock_expires_at > NOW() THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (unlock_expires_at - NOW()))::int ELSE 0 END AS "Sisa Waktu" FROM device_locks WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 🪪 Tap NFC Terakhir
panels.description: Pengguna kartu NFC yang terakhir tap (dari tabel nfc_access_logs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(nama, ' (', uid, ')') AS "Pengguna" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF','NFC_DENIED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 📡 Koneksi ESP32
panels.description: ONLINE bila ada data masuk ke InfluxDB dalam 90 detik terakhir.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN last_seen_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 📶 Sinyal WiFi
panels.description: RSSI WiFi ESP32. ≥ -60 sangat kuat · ≥ -70 baik · ≥ -80 sedang · lebih rendah lemah.

targets.rawSql: SELECT wifi_rssi AS "RSSI" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 🌡️ Sensor DHT11 — Suhu, Kelembapan & Heat Index (PostgreSQL)

targets.rawSql: SELECT temperature_c AS "Suhu" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;
SELECT humidity_pct AS "Kelembapan" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;
SELECT heat_index_c AS "Heat Index" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

SELECT CASE WHEN temperature_c < 22.0 THEN 'Sejuk' WHEN temperature_c <= 28.5 AND humidity_pct >= 35.0 AND humidity_pct <= 70.0 THEN 'Nyaman Ideal' WHEN temperature_c <= 32.0 THEN 'Hangat' ELSE 'Panas' END AS "Kenyamanan" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

SELECT recorded_at AS time, temperature_c AS "Suhu (°C)", humidity_pct AS "Kelembapan (%)", heat_index_c AS "Heat Index (°C)" FROM iot_telemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND device_serial = '$serial' ORDER BY recorded_at ASC;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(temperature_c)::numeric, 1) AS "Suhu Rata-rata" FROM iot_telemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND device_serial = '$serial' AND temperature_c > 0;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(humidity_pct)::numeric, 1) AS "Kelembapan Rata-rata" FROM iot_telemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND device_serial = '$serial' AND humidity_pct > 0;
SELECT MAX(temperature_c) AS "Suhu Tertinggi" FROM iot_telemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND device_serial = '$serial';

panels.title: 📉 Suhu Terendah
panels.description: Memori bebas terendah per interval. Turun terus-menerus = indikasi memory leak.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(temperature_c) AS "Suhu Terendah" FROM iot_telemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND device_serial = '$serial' AND temperature_c > 0;

panels.title: 🪪 Akses NFC & Riwayat Keamanan (PostgreSQL)
panels.description: Kurva naik terus = stabil. Turun ke 0 = ESP32 restart / reboot.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "eternal_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iot_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["serial"] == "${serial}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "uptime_sec")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Uptime (s)"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Uptime (s)"])

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Berhasil" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF');

panels.title: 🔓 Tap Buka Kunci (ON)
panels.description: Jumlah tap yang membuka/mengunci pada rentang waktu dashboard.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Buka (ON)" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON');

panels.title: ⛔ Percobaan Ditolak
panels.description: Kartu tidak terdaftar yang mencoba akses. Banyak penolakan = periksa keamanan.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Ditolak" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type = 'NFC_DENIED';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Kartu Aktif" FROM nfc_users WHERE is_active = 1;
SELECT MAX(created_at) AS "Tap Terakhir" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF','NFC_DENIED');

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Berhasil", SUM(CASE WHEN action_type = 'NFC_DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Ditolak" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT nama AS "Pengguna", COUNT(*) AS "Tap" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type IN ('NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK','NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK','NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK','TAP_ON','TAP_OFF') GROUP BY nama ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT uid AS "UID", nama AS "Nama", username AS "Username", role AS "Role", CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN '✅ AKTIF' ELSE '⛔ NONAKTIF' END AS "Status", total_taps AS "Total Tap", COALESCE(TO_CHAR(last_login_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS "Tap Terakhir" FROM nfc_users ORDER BY id ASC;

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Waktu", uid AS "UID", nama AS "Nama", role AS "Role", CASE action_type WHEN 'NFC_TAP_ON_UNLOCK' THEN '🔓 Buka Kunci (Tap ON)' WHEN 'TAP_ON' THEN '🔓 Buka Kunci (Tap ON)' WHEN 'NFC_REGISTER_UNLOCK' THEN '🔓 Buka Kunci (Daftar Kartu)' WHEN 'NFC_TAP_OFF_LOCK' THEN '🔒 Kunci (Tap OFF)' WHEN 'TAP_OFF' THEN '🔒 Kunci (Tap OFF)' WHEN 'AUTO_LOCK_2H' THEN '⏲️ Auto-Lock 2 Jam' WHEN 'NFC_DENIED' THEN '⛔ Ditolak (Kartu Tidak Terdaftar)' WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_UNLOCK' THEN '🌐 Remote Buka (MQTT)' WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_LOCK' THEN '🌐 Remote Kunci (MQTT)' WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_TOGGLE_ON' THEN '🌐 Remote Buka (MQTT)' WHEN 'MQTT_REMOTE_TOGGLE_OFF' THEN '🌐 Remote Kunci (MQTT)' ELSE action_type END AS "Aksi", lock_duration_sec AS "Durasi (s)", device_ip AS "IP ESP32" FROM nfc_access_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND action_type <> 'REGISTER_USER' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: ⏱️ Uptime
panels.description: Lama ESP32 menyala sejak boot terakhir.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uptime_sec AS "Uptime" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;
SELECT free_heap AS "Free Heap" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

panels.title: 📥 Data Masuk Telemetri (1 jam)
panels.description: Jumlah titik telemetri yang masuk 1 jam terakhir. 0 = pipeline MQTT → API → InfluxDB terputus.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Paket Data" FROM iot_telemetry_logs WHERE recorded_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND device_serial = '$serial';

panels.title: 🔄 Status Sinkron PostgreSQL (iot_devices)
panels.description: Apakah snapshot perangkat di MySQL eternal_db diperbarui dalam 2 menit terakhir.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN updated_at IS NULL THEN 'BELUM ADA DATA' WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - updated_at)) <= 120 THEN 'TERSINKRON' ELSE 'TERTINGGAL' END AS "Status" FROM iot_devices WHERE device_serial = '$serial' LIMIT 1;

SELECT device_serial AS "Serial", device_name AS "Nama", model AS "Model", ip_address AS "IP", mac_address AS "MAC", ssid AS "SSID", firmware_version AS "Firmware", wifi_rssi AS "RSSI (dBm)", status AS "Status", COALESCE(TO_CHAR(last_seen_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS "Terakhir Terlihat" FROM iot_devices ORDER BY device_serial;
